slides.heading: What a pro would do that you didn't ask for
paras: A quant researcher would build and validate the judge before letting any agent search, using planted-signal and pure-noise datasets to measure its false-positive and false-negative rates.

slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: Pure-noise falsifier: 200 GBM and 200 shuffled-return datasets run through the full search; the judge passes at most 5% (target under 1%)…
Planted-signal detection: datasets with a known after-cost Sharpe of 1.5; the judge detects it in a reported share of runs.
